example_sentences_in_bangla: যুদ্ধে সৈন্যরা শত্রুর কাছে লম্বা হয়ে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: The thief was caught by the police.
The soldiers were subdued by the enemy in battle.
note: This idiom metaphorically refers to being overpowered or arrested, evoking imagery of being stretched out or laid flat.
